sheet_name: ขยายจุดต่อ A, ขยายจุดต่อ B / แบบขยายการวางพื้นสำเร็จรูป
source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_08/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_08_หน้า33.png
warnings: Top-left of this sheet shows the CS1-to-RC-column base connection in two cut orientations (labelled '2-2', along BS2, and '1-1', along BS1) — same physical connection type, at every CS1 location (A2/B2/C2), not two different connections. Recorded as one merged element.

'ขยายจุดต่อ A' and 'ขยายจุดต่อ B' (bottom-left of this sheet) are a second, separate pair of plate connections, called out on S-05's plan near B1 (A) and near the A2-B2 vertical (B) respectively — read as the BS1-to-column and BS2-to-CS1 top/mid-height connections, distinct from the CS1 base-plate detail above. Exact which end of which beam each belongs to is not fully certain at this drawing's scale.

'ลักษณะการวางพื้น SP' (SP floor-laying details, right half of sheet) are precast SOLID PLANK laying/topping details, not connection hardware — recorded separately as element_type precast_plank_detail per schema §9.

elements.description: Base connection: steel column CS1 to RC column/pedestal C1 top, via PLATE 200x200x9mm + 4-Ø12mm L-anchor bolts, 0.20m embedment into the RC column. Shown in section 1-1 (along BS1) and section 2-2 (along BS2).
'ขยายจุดต่อ A' — plate connection between a steel tie beam and column, PLATE 200x200x9mm + 4-Ø12mm anchor bolts, called out on S-05 near grid point B1.
confidence_flags: exact beam mark (BS1 vs BS2) and column not fully certain at this scale

elements.description: 'ขยายจุดต่อ B' — plate connection between a steel tie beam and the CS1 ridge column, PLATE 200x200x9mm + 4-Ø12mm anchor bolts, called out on S-05 near the A2-B2 vertical.
confidence_flags: exact beam mark (BS1 vs BS2) not fully certain at this scale
